content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, salary scale, or application fee.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amaravati Campus, invites applications from eligible candidates for faculty positions in the English discipline. The recruitment aims to onboard qualified academicians to engage in teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students, manage the language lab, and contribute to research and administrative responsibilities.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers 1 vacancy for the English department at the Amaravati Campus. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidate should have a good academic record, with a PhD. Degree in English/allied/ relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work.

rows.experience: A minimum of seven years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are required to perform the following duties and responsibilities: UG/PG level teaching. Managing the Language Lab. Serving the department in administrative capacities -as a member of various academic committees. Student mentor and University interface for ranking/ accreditation functions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham jobs portal. Navigate to the Professor/Associate Professor - English job page for the Amaravati Campus. Click on the APPLY NOW button to access the online application form. Submit the required details and complete the application before the deadline of 31 October 2026. For details contact: [email protected] .
